name: Almond-Crusted Chicken with Green Beans & Maple Sweet Potato Mash

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb green beans
2 ¼ lb sweet potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
When pan is hot, add almond meal and bread crumbs to dry pan. Toast, stirring often, until golden brown; about 2 minutes. Transfer the breading mix to a medium bowl and set pan aside to use later.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup almond meal/flour
2 ¼ cup panko bread crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Add salt and pepper to the bowl with the almonds and bread crumbs and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Crack the egg into another medium bowl and beat with a whisk or fork.

One piece at a time, dip chicken fillets in the beaten egg (letting the excess drip off), then in the almond mixture (pressing to adhere) and place on a parchment lined baking sheet. Cook in the center of the oven until golden brown and cooked through; about 18 minutes.

Peel and cut the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes; transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water to the saucepan, covering the potatoes, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until they are tender when pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes.
Trim and discard the ends of the green beans.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and mince or press the garlic.
Add butter to the skillet and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the beans, garlic, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the potatoes are tender, remove from heat, carefully scoop out ¾ cup of the water and set aside. Drain the potatoes in a colander and return them back to the saucepan.
Add maple syrup, butter, salt, pepper and the reserved cooking water (if needed) to the potatoes; mash with a potato masher (or fork) until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide the almond-crusted chicken, green beans, and maple mash between plates. Enjoy!
